title: Rosario+Vampire
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tsukune Aono, an ordinary human, ends up at Yokai Academy, a boarding school for monsters where humans are killed on discovery (to verify). He befriends Moka Akashiya, a vampire whose rosary seals her fierce inner self, and gathers a circle of monster girls, including the succubus Kurumu and the witch Yukari, while fighting school bullies and later a terrorist group (to verify).
life_message: It holds up friendship across difference and the courage of an ordinary person to stand up for those he loves.

content.note: Monster fights, blood-drinking and later war arcs (to verify; Body Horror signal; likely higher).
Ecchi harem comedy with panty shots and a succubus character (to verify; Ecchi genre, MangaDex suggestive; likely higher).
Moka's split identity; Tsukune's loneliness (to verify; Dissociative Identities).
